blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
As generated images become increasingly realistic, reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information.
However, existing methods primarily rely on task-specific supervision to adapt vision foundation model representations, without fully exploiting internal forensic knowledge to guide detection.
To address this limitation, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that treats sparse, origin-sensitive internal components in pretrained models as a forensic reserve and translates their localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation.
Specifically, we first use the Forensic Lens (F-lens) to decompose activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screen them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions.
Next, we map the selected directions back to hidden-state space to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites.
Finally, with the backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases fixed, we train only the FRA coefficient maps to generate input-dependent residual updates constrained to the corresponding subspaces, strengthening existing forensic responses.
Using only 500 labeled training images and a trainable parameter budget below 0.2% of the backbone, RGE achieves competitive performance across three detection benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation.
Furthermore, RGE consistently improves over the corresponding frozen detectors across eight encoders spanning self-supervised and vision-language pretraining, eliciting a latent forensic capacity broadly shared across pretrained vision models.
blocks.zh:
随着生成的图像变得越来越现实,可靠的伪造检测对于维持对视觉信息的信任至关重要.
然而,现有方法主要依靠特定任务的监督来调整愿景基础模型表述,而未充分利用内部法医学知识来指导检测.
为了消除这一局限性,我们提议保留指导的Eligarian(RGE),这个框架将预先训练过的模型中稀有的、对起源敏感的内部组件作为法证储备,并将其本地化转化为轻量级适应的结构性限制。
具体地说,我们首先使用"法证镜头"(F-lens)将跨层和象征组的活化分解为独立的组件,并通过真实图像和生成图像之间的反应差异进行全球筛选,确定保留地和方向.
其次,我们将选定方向映射回隐藏状态空间,以建造固定的后备子空间,并仅在确定的地点插入法医后备适应器。
最后,在主干参数、先前安装的参考分类器和已固定的子空间基准下,我们只培训FRA系数图,以生成受相应子空间制约的依赖输入的剩余更新,加强现有的法证反应。
RGE仅使用500个标有标记的训练图像和低于主干线0.2%的可训练参数预算,在没有目标基准调整的情况下,实现了三个检测基准的竞争性性能.
此外,RGE在8个编码器中不断改进相应的冷冻探测器,这些编码器跨越自我监督和视觉语言的预训,在预先训练的视觉模型中广泛共享潜在的法证能力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent studies ( Yan et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ) show that as generated images become increasingly realistic, distinguishing them from real images becomes more challenging.
Reliable forgery detection is essential for maintaining trust in visual information.
Practical detection methods must also generalize to evolving generators while keeping annotation and training costs manageable.
blocks.zh:
最近的研究(Yan等,2025a; Li等,2025b)显示,随着生成的图像变得越来越现实,将它们与真实图像区分开来就更具挑战性.
可靠的伪造检测对维持对视觉信息的信任至关重要。
实用的检测方法还必须普遍适用于不断发展的发电机,同时使注释和培训费用能够控制。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of Forgery Detection Paradigms. Fine-tuning relies on large labeled sets without localizing forensic evidence; RGE localizes the forensic reserve to guide targeted enhancement of existing internal responses.
blocks.zh: 图1:伪造检测范式比较. 精细调整依赖于大型标有标签的套件,而不将法证证据本地化; RGE将法证储备本地化,以指导有针对性地加强现有内部反应.

blocks.en:
Existing methods approach image forgery detection through explicit artifact analysis and adaptation of pretrained representations.
Artifact-based detectors exploit spatial and frequency statistics ( Li et al., 2025a ) or diffusion reconstruction residuals ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , but their effectiveness depends on whether these cues remain discriminative across generation settings.
Methods based on vision foundation models (VFMs) adapt pretrained representations through forgery supervision, refining training data ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) and parameter updates ( Yan et al., 2026 ) to improve generalization.
As illustrated in Figure 1 (a), these approaches primarily optimize real–fake separation through classification objectives.
However, improved classification does not directly reveal which internal components carry forensic information or specify where and along which directions adaptation should act.
The locations and directions of internal forensic knowledge therefore remain underutilized as structural guidance for targeted enhancement of VFM-based forgery detectors.
blocks.zh:
现有方法通过明确的文物分析和调整预先训练过的表述,处理图像伪造检测。
以人工活性为主的探测器利用空间和频率统计(Li等,2025a)或扩散重建后遗症(Wang等,2023),但其有效性取决于这些提示是否仍然在不同世代环境中具有歧视性.
基于视觉基础模型(VFMs)的方法通过伪造监督,精炼培训数据(Guillaro等,2025;Chen等,2025b)和参数更新(Yan等,2026)来调整预先训练过的表达方式来改进通俗化.
如图1(a)所示,这些办法主要通过分类目标优化实际-假分离。
然而,改进的分类并没有直接显示哪些内部组成部分载有法证信息,也没有具体说明适应应在何处和沿着哪些方向采取行动。
因此,内部法医学知识的地点和方向仍然没有得到充分利用,作为有针对性地加强以VFM为基础的伪造探测器的结构性指导。

blocks.en:
Recent studies ( Koutlis & Papadopoulos, 2024 ; Dou et al., 2026 ) show that forensic information is unevenly distributed across internal features.
This motivates our hypothesis that components carrying image-origin evidence can provide discriminative features and structural priors for adaptation.
Drawing inspiration from cognitive reserve ( Stern, 2002 ) , we refer to sparse, origin-sensitive internal components as a forensic reserve.
Once localized, their sites indicate where adaptation should act, while their mapped directions define the subspaces available for residual updates (Figure 1 (b)).
This structure offers a way to focus limited supervision on enhancing existing forensic responses.
blocks.zh:
近期的研究表明(Koutlis & Papazolos, 2024; Dou等人, 2026),法医信息在内部特征上的分布不均.
这激励了我们的假设,即带有图像证据的组件可以为适应提供歧视性特征和结构前科。
我们从认知储备(Stern, 2002)中汲取灵感,将稀疏的、对起源敏感的内部组件称为法医储备。
一旦本地化,它们的站点就指出适应应在哪里行动,而它们所绘制的方向则界定了可用于剩余更新的子空间(图1(b))。
这一结构提供了一种方法,可以将有限的监督重点放在加强现有的法证对策上。

blocks.en:
Building on this hypothesis, we propose Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE), a framework that translates reserve localization into structural constraints for lightweight adaptation.
Specifically, the Forensic Lens (F-lens) decomposes activations across layers and token groups into independent components and globally screens them by their response differences between real and generated images, identifying reserve sites and directions.
We map the selected directions back into the corresponding hidden-state spaces to construct fixed reserve subspaces and insert Forensic Reserve Adapters (FRA) only at the identified sites.
Each FRA reads the current hidden state to produce an input-dependent residual update constrained to its reserve subspace.
The backbone parameters, previously fitted reference classifier, and subspace bases remain fixed; only the FRA coefficient maps are trained, concentrating limited forgery supervision on the targeted enhancement of existing forensic responses. Our main contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose RGE, a lightweight adaptation framework that localizes and recruits a forensic reserve within pretrained vision models, using sparse, origin-sensitive internal components to guide targeted enhancement for image forgery detection. • We develop F-lens and FRA to connect reserve localization with constrained residual updates. Site ablations and residual-update interventions support the functional contribution of the identified sites and learned residual updates to detection performance. • RGE achieves competitive detection across three main benchmarks without target-benchmark adaptation, using 500 labeled training images and under 0.2% trainable parameters relative to the backbone. Further evaluations show consistent gains over frozen baselines across eight ViT encoders from four model families.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
AI-Generated Image Detection. Artifact-based detectors exploit spatial and frequency signatures in SAFE ( Li et al., 2025a ) or diffusion reconstruction residuals in DIRE ( Wang et al., 2023 ) , but realistic generated images ( Yan et al., 2025a ; Li et al., 2025b ) become harder to detect as these cues grow less discriminative.
Among methods adapting vision foundation models, DRCT ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , B-Free ( Guillaro et al., 2025 ) , and DDA ( Chen et al., 2025b ) refine supervision through reconstruction-based hard negatives, content matching, and pixel- and frequency-aligned image pairs, respectively.
DGS-Net ( Yan et al., 2026 ) and Effort ( Yan et al., 2025b ) instead constrain adaptation through gradient surgery and pretrained weight subspaces, respectively.
Frozen readout methods use CLIP features ( Ojha et al., 2023 ; Cozzolino et al., 2024 ) or perturbation responses ( He et al., 2026 ) , while RINE ( Koutlis & Papadopoulos, 2024 ) uses intermediate-block representations.
DNA ( Dou et al., 2026 ) further localizes sparse forgery-discriminative units and validates their relevance through masking.
However, translating forensic feature localization into concrete adaptation sites and update subspaces for detector enhancement remains largely underexplored.
blocks.zh:
AI-Generated 图像检测. 以人工活性为主的探测器利用SAFE(Li等,2025年a)中的空间和频率特征,或DIRE(Wang等,2023年)中的传播重建残留,但实际生成的图像(Yan等,2025年a; Li等人,2025年b),随着这些线索越来越不具有歧视性,更难发现.
在调整愿景基础模型的方法中,DRCT(Chen等,2024年),B-Free(Guillaro等,2025年)和DDA(Chen等,2025年b)分别通过基于重建的硬底片,内容相匹配,以及像素相通和频率相通的图像对等来完善监督.
DGS-Net (Yan等, 2026年)和Eft (Yan等, 2025年b)转而通过梯度外科手术和预训重量子空间限制适应.
冷冻读出方法使用CLIP特征(Ojha等,2023;Cozzolino等,2024)或扰动响应(He等,2026),而RINE(Koutlis等,2024)使用中间块表示.
DNA(Dou等,2026年)将稀有的伪造-歧视单位进一步本地化,并通过蒙面验证其相关性.
然而,将法证特征本地化转化为具体的适应地点并更新用于探测器增强的子空间仍然在很大程度上未得到充分探索。

blocks.en:
Latent Features and Targeted Adaptation. Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) ( Huben et al., 2024 ) learn sparse dictionaries from activations, while ICA Lens ( Liu & Han, 2026 ) provides independent component coordinates and associated reading and writing maps.
J-lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) and TraceRouter ( Shi et al., 2026 ) demonstrate targeted control through concept-coordinate swaps and activation rescaling along identified propagation paths, respectively.
In vision, feature suppression ( Joseph et al., 2025 ) improves CLIP robustness, while sparse steering ( Chatzoudis et al., 2025 ) examines the benefits of feature-level edits and limitations of reconstruction-based feature selection.
Feature steering typically applies prescribed activation edits, while SAE-FT ( Morelli et al., 2026 ) uses sparse feature structure to regularize visual-encoder and classifier fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
初级特征和有针对性的适应。 Sparse自定义编码器(SAEs)(Huben等,2024年)从活化中学习到稀疏的词典;而ICA Lens(Liu & Han,2026年)则提供独立的组件坐标和相关的读写地图.
J-lens(Gurnee等人,2026年)和Trace Router(Shi等人,2026年)分别通过概念坐标交换和按照确定的传播途径活化来显示目标控制。
在视觉中,地物压制(Joseph等,2025年)提高了CLIP的稳健性,而零星的向导(Chatzoudis等,2025年)则研究地物一级编辑的好处和基于重建的地物选择的局限性.
地物向导一般应用所规范的活化编辑,而SAE-FT(Morelli等,2026年)则使用稀有地物结构来规范视觉-编码器和分级器的微调.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of Reserve-Guided Elicitation (RGE). F-lens localizes the forensic reserve in the frozen backbone (Section 3.1 ); FRA writes within the mapped reserve subspaces at selected sites (Section 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: 图2:储备指导的Eligarian概览(RGE)。 F-Lens将法医储备放在被冻结的骨干上(第3.1节);FRA在选定地点的已绘制的储备子空间内写作(第3.2节)。

blocks.en: Given a pretrained vision backbone and a labeled discovery set, we fit a linear classifier to the frozen pooled representation and set its decision threshold on a held-out development split, forming a baseline reference detector. This detector uses forensic evidence only as far as the frozen computation carries it to the output; origin-sensitive responses inside the network remain a latent reserve on which the readout does not act. RGE elicits this reserve in two stages (Figure 2 ). Forensic reserve localization (upper row) operates on the unadapted backbone: F-lens decomposes internal activations and identifies origin-sensitive components, whose directions are then mapped into fixed writing subspaces. Targeted adaptation (lower row) then places FRA at the identified sites to learn residual writes confined to these subspaces. The backbone’s intrinsic forensic structure thus determines where, and along which directions, supervision may change the network’s internal representation.
blocks.zh: 鉴于一个预先经过训练的视觉主干线和一个标有标签的发现集,我们把一个线性分类器与被冻结的集合代表物相匹配,并将其决定阈值设定在被搁置的开发分拆上,形成一个基准参考探测器. 这种探测器只在被冻结的计算将其带入输出时才使用法证;网络内对原产地敏感的反应仍然是潜在的保留地,读出时不采取行动。 RGE分两个阶段获得这一储备(图2)。 法证预备队本地化(上行)在未适应的骨干上运作: F-lens会分解内部活化并识别出原产地敏感组件,其方向再被映射为固定的写子空间. 定向调整(下行)然后将FRA放入已查明的站点去学习局限于这些子空间的剩余书写. 因此,骨干部的内在法证结构决定了监督在何地和方向上可能改变网络的内部代表性。

blocks.en: 3.1 Forensic Reserve Localization
blocks.zh: 3.1 法证储备

blocks.en: Discovery Set. We use a labeled discovery set to characterize the pretrained backbone’s internal responses to image origin. The set balances real and fake images while covering multiple real-image domains and generation or manipulation families. Sampling distributes coverage across underlying sources and generator families before adding further examples from the same groups. Passing these images through the frozen backbone yields the activation populations analyzed by F-lens; their real–fake labels subsequently guide component selection. This procedure uses a limited labeled collection to locate the forensic reserve that will guide elicitation. The same discovery images support reference-classifier fitting, reserve localization, and subsequent FRA training. For a given backbone and discovery configuration, localization is performed once; the selected sites and mapped writing bases remain fixed throughout adaptation and are reused across evaluation benchmarks. The set is assembled from public sources independently of the target benchmarks, and the resulting detector is applied to them directly, without fitting any part of RGE to benchmark data. Appendix A details source curation, group-disjoint development splits, and hierarchical sampling.
blocks.zh: 发现集. 我们用一个标有标签的发现集来描述预先训练过的骨干对图像源的内部反应. 该套集平衡了真实和假图像,同时涵盖了多个真实图像域和生成或操纵家族. 抽样在补充来自同一群体的更多例子之前,将覆盖面分布在基本来源和发电机家庭。 通过被冷冻的骨干传递这些图像,会产生由F-lens分析的活化群;它们的真假标签随后引导组件的选择. 这一程序使用有限标签的收集,以找到指导诱导的法证储备。 同样的发现图像支持参考分类器的安装,保留本地化,以及随后的FRA训练. 在特定的主干和发现配置方面,局部化一次;选定地点和所绘制的书写基础在整个适应过程中保持不变,并在评价基准中重新使用。 这套装置是独立于目标基准的公共来源组装而成的,由此产生的探测器直接应用到它们,而没有将RGE的任何部分用于基准数据. 附 录 详细信息为源解析,组分分开发,分级采样.

blocks.en:
Component Probing. For localization to guide adaptation, each discovered component must remain tied to its source in the model. We therefore collect hidden states at the output of each transformer block and organize them into sites c = ( ℓ , t ) c=(\ell,t) , where ℓ \ell denotes the block and t t a token group present in the architecture, such as classification (CLS), register, or patch tokens. Let h c , p 0 ​ ( x ) h^{0}_{c,p}(x) denote the unadapted representation of token p p at site c c for image x x . We collect CLS and register tokens where present and spatially sample patch tokens to form an activation population for each site. Decomposing these populations separately preserves the block and token-group identity of every resulting component, allowing its location to guide adapter placement.
At each site, F-lens normalizes activations by their ℓ 2 \ell_{2} norms and centers them by the site mean. It then follows an independent component analysis (ICA) workflow ( Hyvärinen, 1999 ; Hyvärinen & Oja, 2000 ; Liu & Han, 2026 ) to express these activations in signed component coordinates. We scale each component to unit empirical variance, obtaining the final reading map R c R_{c} and coordinates z c , p ​ ( x ) z_{c,p}(x) . This common scale expresses response contrasts from all components and sites in the same standardized units, so that they can be ranked jointly. Each coordinate now describes an individually measurable response.
F-lens can therefore examine which components carry real–fake contrasts within each site, giving reserve localization both a position in the network and a component-level description. These responses are scored in the next module to identify the reserve available for targeted elicitation.

F-Lens在每一站点 都会按自己的规范来激活 并且按站点来定位 然后遵循独立的组件分析(ICA)工作流程(Hyvärinen,1999;Hyvärinen & Oja,2000;Liu & Han,2026),以签名组件坐标表示这些激活. 我们将每个组件缩放为单位经验差异,获得最终读取地图R c R_{c}并坐标为z c,p (x) z_{c,p} (x). 这个共同的尺度表达了与同个标准化单元中所有组件和站点的响应对比,这样它们就可以被联合排列. 现在,每个协调处都说明单个可衡量的反应。
因此,F-Lens可以检查每个站点内哪些组件具有真实的-假对比,使备用本地化既可以在网络中占据一个位置,也可以在组件一级进行描述. 这些答复在下一个单元中打分,以确定可供有针对性地引领的储备。

Reserve Identification. Adapting class-contrast feature selection ( Liu & Han, 2026 ) , we identify reserve components by their origin sensitivity, defined for component j j at site c c as s c , j = | 𝔼 ⁡ [ z c , p , j ​ ( x ) ∣ y = 1 ] − 𝔼 ⁡ [ z c , p , j ​ ( x ) ∣ y = 0 ] | , s_{c,j}=\left|\mathbb{E}\!\left[z_{c,p,j}(x)\mid y=1\right]-\mathbb{E}\!\left[z_{c,p,j}(x)\mid y=0\right]\right|, (1) where y = 0 y=0 and y = 1 y=1 denote real and fake images, respectively, and the expectations are empirical averages over each class’s sampled token activations. Taking the absolute difference ranks components by the strength of their real–fake response contrast, whether their mean response is higher for real or fake images. A large score therefore identifies an existing internal direction whose response is sensitive to image origin. Because the coordinates at a site are a rotation of its whitened activations, ∑ j s c , j 2 \sum_{j}s_{c,j}^{2} equals the squared Mahalanobis distance between the class means at that site, so the scores distribute each site’s origin separation across its components.
We retain the top K K components globally across all fitted sites according to origin sensitivity. A single global budget allows the number of selected components to vary across sites according to their response contrasts, so sites where origin separation is concentrated contribute more components to the reserve. The reserve is thus drawn from the backbone’s full repertoire of origin-sensitive components, spanning layers and token groups, rather than from a preset location. These selected, site-indexed components constitute the forensic reserve. Let ℐ c \mathcal{I}_{c} collect their indices at site c c ; sites with nonempty selections form 𝒞 ⋆ \mathcal{C}_{\star} , specifying where adapters will be inserted. At each selected site, the component-coordinate axes span the component subspace F c = span ⁡ { e j : j ∈ ℐ c } F_{c}=\operatorname{span}\{e_{j}:j\in\mathcal{I}_{c}\} , where e j e_{j} is the corresponding coordinate axis. We call this family of selected subspaces the forensic reserve space (F-space), which supplies the directions for reserve mapping. The selected sites specify where elicitation should act, grounding adapter placement in the backbone’s existing origin-sensitive responses. Within each site, the retained components supply the directions to be mapped into the corresponding writing subspace. The global budget thus organizes both the locations and directional content of the reserve used for adaptation. Appendix B details activation collection, ICA fitting, and component selection.

blocks.en: Forensic Reserve Adapter at Selected Sites. At each selected site c c , FRA augments the reference detector with a residual branch that updates the current hidden state h c , p h_{c,p} ; adding this residual to h c , p h_{c,p} yields the representation passed to subsequent blocks. Each branch applies token-wise within its designated group, with its parameters shared across tokens at that site and separate parameters at different sites. A selected patch branch operates on all native patch tokens, so each token receives coefficients computed from its own hidden state within the same writing subspace. As the representation proceeds through the network, subsequent adapters read states that already include the effects of earlier writes. The final output representation then reaches the retained classifier, whose unchanged readout connects these local elicitation steps to the image-level detection score.

Forensic Reserve Adapter. Each branch updates the current hidden state with a residual write as h c , p ′ = h c , p + U c ​ A c ​ h c , p , h^{\prime}_{c,p}=h_{c,p}+U_{c}A_{c}h_{c,p}, (3) where A c ∈ ℝ r c × d c A_{c}\in\mathbb{R}^{r_{c}\times d_{c}} is the learned coefficient map. It reads the complete current hidden state to produce input-dependent coefficients. Multiplication by the fixed basis U c U_{c} confines the residual to the mapped reserve subspace. The residual map U c ​ A c U_{c}A_{c} therefore has rank at most r c r_{c} , with its column space contained in the mapped reserve subspace: U c U_{c} determines where in the representation a write can go, while A c A_{c} learns which features of the current state drive it. Whereas low-rank adaptation (LoRA) ( Hu et al., 2022 ) learns both factors of an update, FRA inherits its output factor from discovery and learns only how to read. Elicitation is input-dependent within this fixed structure: the coefficient map determines how the reserve directions are combined for each input token, including the sign and magnitude of the resulting write.
Each A c A_{c} is initialized to zero, so the augmented model initially reproduces the reference detector. We train only these coefficient maps with binary cross-entropy on the labeled discovery set, keeping the backbone parameters, classifier, and writing bases fixed. Gradients propagate through the fixed detector to adjust how the reserve directions are combined for each input. With the classifier fixed, optimization adjusts the internal representations to improve real–fake discrimination under the same readout. Because the writes start from zero and remain confined to reserve directions, detection gains are expressed along the backbone’s own origin-sensitive directions, so RGE largely elicits forensic evidence the backbone already encodes. This gives the two stages complementary roles in reserve-guided elicitation: discovery establishes the sites and writing subspaces, while supervision learns the coefficient maps that use this structure for detection. The trainable parameter count is ∑ c ∈ 𝒞 ⋆ r c ​ d c \sum_{c\in\mathcal{C}_{\star}}r_{c}d_{c} , tying the adaptation budget to the selected sites and their writing-subspace dimensions. At inference, the augmented backbone and retained classifier directly score query images with the learned adapters. Appendix B details the basis construction and the full optimization protocol.

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: Quantitative Results. We first compare RGE with eight state-of-the-art detectors on AIGIBench, Chameleon, and HiRes-50K (Table 1 ). With only 500 labeled discovery images and no target-benchmark adaptation, RGE achieves the highest available mAP and Acc among the compared methods on all three benchmarks. It reaches 90.98% mAP and 88.05% Acc on AIGIBench, 95.42% and 91.20% on Chameleon, and 97.66% and 92.99% on HiRes-50K. Its lead over the strongest competitor, DDA, grows from 0.78 mAP on AIGIBench to 4.22 and 3.96 on Chameleon and HiRes-50K. Both benchmarks limit the cues that detectors most readily exploit: Chameleon retains only generated images that human annotators judged real, and HiRes-50K contains images of up to 64 megapixels whose fine artifacts are obscured at standard input resolution. Where perceptual realism and high resolution leave few surface artifacts to learn, detection increasingly depends on evidence that the backbone’s representations already encode, and these results indicate that the forensic reserve remains informative in this regime once it is elicited. This reserve is intrinsic to the pretrained backbone rather than acquired from large-scale forgery supervision: the strongest competitors are trained on 144K–473K images (Appendix A ), whereas 500 discovery images suffice for RGE to elicit it. Appendix D breaks these results down by source category and resolution interval.

blocks.en: Scaling with Discovery Data. To further reveal the full potential of the forensic reserve in VFMs, we investigate how RGE scales with discovery data. The 0.5K detector is fitted on only 500 images yet evaluated on benchmark sets of approximately 26K–359K images each, and Figure 3 (a) follows how this capability develops as the discovery set grows. RGE improves on the baseline at every displayed size, reaching 97.58% mAP and 93.41% mBA at 5K, and 98.17% mAP and 94.69% mBA at 20K. The 0.5K configuration therefore does not exhaust the reserve: additional discovery data continue to strengthen its observable expression, while the gains taper beyond 5K, where quadrupling the discovery set to 20K adds 0.59 mAP and 1.28 mBA. The 5K configuration thus captures much of the observed improvement at a moderate data cost, and all subsequent analyses use it.

blocks.en: Qualitative Results. To visually examine where the detector finds its evidence and how the elicited writes relate to it, we compute sensitivity maps (Appendix C ). Figure 3 (b) shows the final-score sensitivity S final S_{\mathrm{final}} for independent real and fake portrait, dog, and large-cat pairs. In each fake image, sensitivity peaks on the generated subject, including the face, the dog’s head, and the tiger’s face and front leg, whereas real images show no such peaks. The detector’s evidence for a fake decision thus lies on the synthesized content. The localized-write sensitivity S write S_{\mathrm{write}} , which isolates the contribution of the discovery-selected write group of Figure 4 (a), peaks in the same regions (Appendix C ), indicating that the reserve-elicited writes act on the image regions that also shape the final decision.

blocks.en: Reserve Localization. Forensic information is distributed unevenly across the layer–token sites analyzed by F-lens. Figure 4 (a) relates this internal organization to the learned writes. Out-of-fold probe AP, shown on the outer rings, measures the discriminative information in fixed component representations before adaptation, while mean label-aligned gate integrated gradients (IG) ( Sundararajan et al., 2017 ) attribute changes in the detection margin to learned writes and are shown on the inner rings; Appendix C defines both quantities. Both maps are uneven, and the layer-15 register site is strongest in both: a location with highly accessible forensic information also makes a prominent contribution after adaptation. The reserve is thus unevenly weighted across sites, and the sites where it is most accessible before adaptation are among those where elicitation contributes most.
blocks.zh: 储备地化. 法医信息分布在F-lens分析的地层各站点之间。 图4(a)将这一内部组织与所学著作联系起来。 在外环上显示的外侧探针AP在适应前用固定成份表示法测量出有区别的信息,而平均值为标签相通门集成梯度(IG)(Sundarajan等,2017年) 将检测比值的属性变化归为所学写作,并显示于内环;附录C定义了这两个量. 两种地图均不均匀,地层-15的注册站点在两者中都最强:一个具有高度可获取的法证信息的位置在适应后也做出了突出贡献. 因此,保护区在各地点的加权不均,在适应之前最容易进入的场地属于引出因素最多的地方。

blocks.en: Site Knockout. To test this correspondence by intervention, we disable six writing sites selected by discovery-set probe AP and compare them with three random six-site groups of approximately matched total rank. On the stratified 2,000-image AIGIBench analysis panel, removing the discovery-selected group reduces mBA by 3.60 points, versus 0.60–1.05 points for the random groups (Figure 4 (a), center). Measured without retraining, this loss is 3.4–6.0 times that of a random group with approximately matched writing rank, so the sites that discovery ranks highest are also where the elicited writes matter most for detection, although this ranking precedes adaptation.
blocks.zh: 现场击倒。 为了通过干预测试这些函证,我们禁用由发现设置探测器AP所选择的6个写作站点,并将它们与3个随机的6个站点组进行对比,总排名大致相当. 在分级为2000-image AIGIBench分析面板上,去掉被发现所选择的组将mBA减少3.60分,相对于随机组的0.60–1.05分(图4(a),中心). 在不进行再培训的情况下,这种损失是随机群体大约对应写作等级的3.4至6.0倍,因此发现排名最高的地点也是被引出者写作最需要检测的地方,尽管这一排名在适应之前。

blocks.en: Writing Depth. We next restrict component selection and adaptation to one depth band at a time, keeping the total component budget fixed, to examine how depth affects elicitation (Figure 4 (b)). Middle-layer writes (L11–21) achieve 97.21 mAP and 92.92 mBA, recovering 93.5% and 98.0% of full RGE’s respective improvements over the baseline. Both scores exceed those of the shallow- and deep-layer variants, while full RGE achieves the highest performance at 97.58 mAP and 93.41 mBA. The middle band therefore holds the most elicitable reserve, and the global budget of full RGE, which also retains shallow and deep components, adds the remaining improvement. Beyond their discriminative utility, the identified reserves remain broadly consistent across discovery subsets, with relatively low variance in their selected sites, suggesting that F-lens tends to recover shared forensic structure rather than subset-specific components.
blocks.zh: 写入深度 。 我们接下来将选择和调整组件限制在一个深度范围,使整个组件预算保持不变,以审查深度如何影响引出(图4(b))。 中层写作(L11–21)实现了97.21 mAP和92.92 mBA,恢复了全部RGE各自比基线改善的93.5%和98.0%. 两个分数都超过了浅层和深层变体的分数,而全RGE则以97.58 mAP和93.41 mBA的分数实现了最高的性能. 因此,中波段拥有最引人入胜的储备,全球全额RGE预算也保留了浅而深的部分,从而增加了剩余的改进. 除了具有歧视性的效用外,查明的保护区在各发现子集之间仍然大体一致,其选定的地点差异相对较低,这表明F-lens倾向于恢复共享的法证结构,而不是子集特定的组成部分。

blocks.zh: 表2:AIGIBench上的适应结构。 家长从RGE中减少。

blocks.en: Adaptation Structure. To isolate what the reserve structure contributes, we alter its components, their allocation, or the constraint on the update. Random-In keeps RGE’s sites and per-site counts but draws each site’s components at random from its non-reserve ICA components, while Bottom-K retains the components with the lowest origin sensitivity at the same sites and counts. Random-Ex excludes all reserve components and draws the same total number of components across the full grid, with sites determined by the draw. CLS-Budget Reallocation moves the CLS budget to patch/register sites. Free-LoRA learns unconstrained low-rank updates to the attention-output and MLP-down projections of the layers that contain reserve sites, with ranks set to match RGE’s trainable-parameter count. Random Weight Coordinates learns updates to scalar entries sampled uniformly without replacement from all backbone linear weight matrices, with the number of selected entries matched to RGE’s trainable-parameter count. All adapted variants use matched trainable capacity. The three selection controls form a graded comparison (Table 2 (a)): random non-reserve components at RGE’s sites (Random-In) cost less than random components elsewhere in the network (Random-Ex), and the lowest-scoring components at the same sites (Bottom-K) cost most. Detection therefore follows the F-lens score both within and across sites, and components outside the reserve do not fully substitute for it. With matched trainable capacity, reallocating the CLS budget or removing the subspace constraint also falls short of RGE (b), with Free-LoRA trailing by 2.44 mAP; at matched capacity, the remaining gain comes from where and along which directions the parameters act.
blocks.zh: 适应结构. 为了孤立储备结构的贡献,我们改变其组成部分、其分配或对更新的限制。 随机 保留RGE的站点和每站点计数,但从非保留地ICA组件中随机抽取每个站点的组件,而下-K则保留同一站点和计数中来源敏感度最低的组件. 随机 ex不包括所有储备组件,并绘制出整个网格的相同组件总数,站点由绘图决定. CLS-预算重置将 CLS 预算移动到补丁/注册站点. Free-LORA学习了对包含保留地的地层的注意力输出和MLP下行预测的不受限制的低级更新,其排位设定与RGE的可训练参数计数一致. 随机加权坐标学在没有从所有主干线性加权矩阵中替换的情况下统一抽取出标分条目的更新,选定条目的数量与RGE的可训练参数计数相匹配. 所有经过改造的变体都使用相匹配的可训练能力。 三种选择控制形成分级比较(表2(a):RGE的站点(Random-In)的随机非保留部件的成本低于网络其他站点(Random-Ex)的随机组件,同一站点(Bottom-K)的得分最低的组件成本最高. 因此,在现场内部和不同地点的F-lens评分之后进行检测,而储备之外的组成部分不能完全取代储备。 具有相匹配的可训练能力,重新分配CLS预算或去除子空间制约也低于RGE(b),Free-LORA排行榜在2.44 mAP后;相匹配能力下,剩余收益来自参数作用的地点和方向.

blocks.en: Component-Level Separation. To observe elicitation within a single reserve component, we compare its responses in a fixed ICA coordinate before and after adaptation. Figure 4 (c) shows substantially reduced overlap between real and fake image responses on the same images. Because the coordinate and its readout are fixed by discovery, this separation reflects the adapted response along a reserve direction, not a redefined measurement axis.
blocks.zh: 组件级分离。 为了在单一储备部分内观察到诱导,我们在适应前后用一个固定的ICA坐标比较其反应。 图4(c)显示,在同一图像上真实的和假的图像反应之间的重叠大大减少。 由于坐标及其读取是通过发现固定的,这种分离反映了沿储备方向而调整的反应,而不是重新定义的测量轴.

blocks.en: Cumulative Removal. Having examined how discovery structures learning, we test how the learned FRA writes sustain detection. Figure 5 (a–b) progressively disables writes in the trained 0.5K, 5K, and 20K detectors, following either their gate-IG ranking, computed on 2,000 AIGIBench images for each detector, or random orders. By 24 disabled sites, IG-ranked removal yields lower mAP and mBA than the random-order mean in all three configurations. Removing all writes reduces mAP by 1.69–6.01 points and mBA by 17.65–25.50 points. These interventions leave the backbone and classifier fixed and involve no retraining, directly connecting the learned internal updates to both ranking quality and balanced classification at all three discovery sizes (0.5K, 5K, and 20K).
blocks.zh: 累积清除。 在研究了发现结构如何学习后,我们测试了学习的FRA如何写作维持了检测. 图5(a-b)在经过训练的0.5K、5K和20K探测器中逐渐禁用,或按每台探测器的2 000个AIGIBench图像计算,或按随机顺序计算。 由24个被禁用站点,IG排名的去除比所有三种配置的随机顺序平均值的mAP和mBA产量更低. 删除所有写作后,mAP减少1.69–6.01分,mBA减少17.65–25.50分. 这些干预措施使主干和分类器固定下来,不涉及再培训,直接将所学到的内部更新与所有三个发现大小(0.5K、5K和20K)的排名质量和平衡分类联系起来。

blocks.en:
Write Gate. Restoring the trained updates reveals how their contribution translates into individual decisions. On the stratified 2,000-image AIGIBench analysis panel, we increase a global write gate g g (Appendix C ) from zero to one without retraining, while retaining the classifier’s decision boundary. Balanced accuracy rises from 68.80% to 92.85% across the tested gate levels (Figure 5 (c)). Restoring the writes corrects 511 previously incorrect predictions and reverses 30 correct ones, yielding 481 additional correct decisions (Figure 5 (d)).
The elicited writes thus change decisions overwhelmingly in the correct direction, with 17 corrections for every reversal.
blocks.zh:
写出出门. 恢复训练有素的更新说明他们的贡献如何转化为个人决定。 在分级的2000-图像AIGIGIBench分析面板上,我们将一个全局写出gg(附录C)的门从零增加到一而无需再培训,同时保留分类者的决定界限. 在测试的大门水平上,平衡的精度从68.80%上升到92.85%(图5(c))。 恢复写作纠正了之前的511个不正确的预测,倒行30个正确的预测,得出了481个额外的正确决定(图5(d))。
因此,引证的书写绝大多数决定都朝着正确的方向改变,每次逆转都要作17个更正。

blocks.en: Cross-Backbone Evaluation. Reserve-guided elicitation extends across ViT architectures, capacities, and pretraining families. Figure 6 (a) compares eight backbones from DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2026 ) , DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2024 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , and SigLIP2 ( Tschannen et al., 2025 ) , each with its fitted classifier. RGE improves mAP over every corresponding baseline. DINOv3-H+ reaches 97.58% mAP, while DINOv2-L and DINOv2-Giant gain 11.51 and 21.29 points, respectively. Enhancement therefore benefits both a strong initial ranking representation and models with larger room for improvement. Each pretraining family carries its own forensic repertoire, yet the same localize-and-elicit procedure recruits a reserve from it in every case, with the attainable improvement depending on the model rather than on family-specific tuning.

DINov3-H+达到97.58%的mAP,而DINov2-L和DINov2-Giant分别得到11.51分和21.29分. 因此,改进既有利于建立强有力的初始排名代表性,也有利于有较大改进余地的模式。 每个培训前家庭都有自己的法证汇编,但同一地方化和合法程序在每一个案件中都从中招聘了后备人员,其可实现的改进取决于模式,而不是取决于具体家庭的调整。

Component Selection Budget. The retained component fraction also affects detection. In the budget sweep, increasing the fraction from 0.1% to 1% improves both metrics; 2% adds only 0.02 mAP and 0.27 mBA points, while 5% reduces both relative to 1%.
A compact reserve therefore suffices: beyond about 1% of the candidate components, additional components contribute little and eventually reduce detection. The default 1% lies near the best observed performance (Figure 6 (b)) while keeping the trainable parameters below 0.2% of the backbone; Appendix C reports the corresponding writing ranks and trainable capacities.
blocks.zh:
构成部分选择预算。 所保留的组件分数也会影响检测。 在预算扫描中,将分数从0.1%提高到1%,这两个度数都有所改善;2%只增加了0.02个mAP和0.27个mBA分数,而5%的分数都比1%减少。
因此,一个紧凑的储备就足够了:除了大约1%的候选部件外,额外部件贡献不大,最终减少探测。 默认的1%位于观测到的最佳性能附近(图6(b)),而可训练参数则保持在主干线的0.2%以下;附录C报告了相应的书写级别和可训练能力.

blocks.en: Robustness to Image Perturbations. The benefit of the learned writes also persists under common image perturbations. Figure 7 (a) evaluates clean images and six independently applied JPEG, resizing, and blurring conditions on the 20,000-image AIGIBench analysis subset. RGE maintains a 3.03–10.64-point mAP advantage over the baseline across all seven conditions. Resizing preserves its mAP, JPEG compression widens the advantage, and blurring narrows it. Even blurring, which removes the most fine image detail, leaves the elicited detector more discriminative than its baseline, so the elicited evidence is not confined to fragile high-frequency traces. Figure 7 (b) provides example spatial responses under these perturbations. Across all six perturbations, the high-sensitivity region of the fake example stays in place, while the real example remains uniformly low.
blocks.zh: 强力到图像扰动。 在共同的图像扰动下,所学著作的好处也依然存在。 图7 (a) 评估了清洁图像和6个独立应用的JPEG,重新大小,并模糊了20 000-图像AIGIGIBench分析子集的条件。 RGE在所有7个条件中保持3.03–10.64分的mAP比基线优势. 缩放可以保留其mAP,JPEG压缩可以拓宽优势并模糊其收缩. 甚至模糊不清,可以去除最精细的图像细节,使得被引出探测器比其基线更具有歧视性,因此被引出的证据并不局限于脆弱的高频痕迹. 图7(b)提供了这些扰动下的空间反应实例。 在所有六个扰动中,假例子的高敏感性区域保持不变,而实际例子却始终很低。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced RGE to discover forensic reserve within vision models and turn it into targeted detection enhancement. F-lens localizes origin-sensitive components whose locations specify adaptation sites and whose mapped directions define fixed writing subspaces; the forensic reserve adapter learns input-dependent residual writes within them. Our findings show that internal forensic knowledge supplies both evidence for classification and concrete targets for enhancing detection. RGE achieves strong detection across three main benchmarks with as few as 500 labeled discovery images and no target-benchmark adaptation; its gains also extend across multiple ViT backbones. More broadly, pretrained vision models hold a forensic repertoire that pooled readout leaves underused; locating a reserve within it and eliciting that reserve offers a data-efficient route to detection that does not depend on ever larger forgery corpora.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了RGE,在视觉模型中发现法证储备,并将其转化为有针对性的检测增强. F-lens将原产地敏感部件本地化,这些部件的地点指定了适应地点,其绘图方向界定了固定的写作子空间;法证储备适配器在其中学习依赖输入的剩余写作. 我们的调查结果显示,内部法医知识既提供了分类证据,也提供了加强侦查的具体目标。 RGE在三个主要基准上实现了强检测,只有500个标有标签的发现图像,没有目标基准的适应;其收益还延伸到多个ViT主干道. 更广泛地说,经过预先训练的视觉模型有一个法证记录,集合读出叶未得到充分利用;在其中找到一个保留地并引出这种保留地提供了一种数据效率高的检测途径,而这种途径并不依赖于更大的伪造公司。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This study uses publicly released datasets and open-weight pretrained models. No additional sensitive personal data were collected. Several source datasets contain human faces; we use these datasets as released, in accordance with their respective terms, and do not redistribute their images. Detection results may reflect biases in the source datasets and pretrained backbones, and performance can vary across generators, content domains, and image conditions. Forensic detectors also pose dual-use risks: knowledge of the internal cues they rely on could facilitate attempts to evade detection. RGE is intended to support rather than replace human judgment. Any deployment should include validation in the target setting and human oversight.

blocks.en: Discovery Set Construction. We construct the discovery set from openly released real, generated, and visually manipulated images. Fake images cover GAN-based synthesis and pixel-space diffusion ( Park & Owens, 2025 ) , latent diffusion ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Livernoche et al., 2025 ; Complex Data Lab, n.d. ) , commercial image generation and editing ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) , and face swapping, editing, and synthesis ( Shao et al., 2023 ; Yan et al., 2024 ) . Real images span natural and social photography ( Yang et al., 2016 ; Unsplash, 2026 ; Kuznetsova et al., 2020 ) , human-designed graphics ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , documents and receipts ( Pfitzmann et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2019 ) , and archival scans ( Library of Congress, n.d. ; British Library Labs, 2014 ) . A metadata-driven profiling and curation workflow organizes these images into class-balanced discovery pools with controlled redundancy, broad coverage, and consistent partitions.
blocks.zh: 发现集建设. 我们用公开发布、生成和视觉操纵的图像来构建这些发现。 假图像涵盖基于GAN的合成和像素-空间扩散(Park & Owens,2025年),潜在扩散(Chen等,2025年a;Livernoche等,2025年;Complex Data Lab, n.d.),商业图像生成和编辑(Zhang等,2026年b.;Zhou等,2026年b.)和相相换,编辑和合成(Shao等,2023年;Yan等,2024年). 真实图像横跨自然和社会摄影(Yang等,2016;Unsplash等,2026;Kuznetsova等,2020.),由人类设计的图形(Chen等,2026.),文件和收据(Pfitzmann等,2022;Park等,2019.),以及档案扫描(国会图书馆,n.d.;英国图书馆实验室,2014.). 由元数据驱动的剖析和校准工作流程将这些图像组织成具有可控冗余、广泛覆盖和相容分区的类平衡发现池。

blocks.en: Image Metadata. Each record links an image to its provenance, content label, and source-origin group. Real images carry a content domain, underlying source, and source variant; fake images carry a generation or manipulation category, generator family, and generator identity. We also record the capture format, source version, native dimensions, codec, color mode, and byte size. Decoding supplies EXIF-oriented RGB8 dimensions, a pixel-identity hash, and a 64-bit perceptual hash. These attributes connect duplicate handling and sampling to the same image identity.
blocks.zh: 图像元数据。 每张记录将一幅图像与其出处、内容标签和出处组联系起来。 真实图像包含一个内容域,基础源,和源变体;假图像包含一个生成或被操纵类,生成家族,和生成者身份. 我们还记录捕获格式,源版本,本土维度,代码,颜色模式,和字节大小. 解码提供以EXIF为导向的RGB8维,像素识别散列,以及64位能感知散列. 这些属性将重复处理和采样连接到相同的图像身份.

blocks.en: Technical Quality Assessment. We admit readable, decodable primary images with resolved labels and applicable domain or manipulation categories. Missing or corrupted payloads, auxiliary assets, and unresolved labels are excluded with an explicit reason. Fake labels refer to generated or visually manipulated pixels; text-only manipulations are not admitted as fake images. Native image representations, including any officially released preprocessing, are retained; resolution and encoding enter the composition profile. For released video frames, at most four evenly spaced frames are retained per generator and source-video group to limit temporal repetition.
blocks.zh: 技术质量评估. 我们承认可读、可解码的原始图像,其标签和适用领域或操纵类别已经解决。 遗失或损坏的有效载荷、辅助资产和未解决的标签被明确排除。 假名标签指被生成或被视觉所操纵的像素;只使用文字的操纵不被承认为假相. 原生图像表示,包括任何正式发布的预处理,都保留;解析和编码输入成份配置. 对于已发布的视频帧,每个生成器和源视频组最多保留了四个均匀相距帧来限制时间重复.

blocks.en: Identity-Aware Deduplication. We remove redundant examples separately within the real and fake classes. Face manipulations and local edits can closely resemble their real originals, so visual similarity across labels does not trigger duplicate removal. Within each class, EXIF-oriented RGB8 pixel identity and declared source identity identify exact repeats. Direct perceptual-hash matches require Hamming distance at most two and relative aspect-ratio difference at most 1%, comparing real images across sources and fake images within the same generator. Representatives favor larger native images, then lossless encoding, with seeded tie-breaking. Pixel-identical records with conflicting labels are handled separately as label conflicts.
blocks.zh: 身份识别 - 智能复制。 在真实和假的课中,我们分别删除多余的例子。 相貌操控和本地编辑可以近似其真正的原作,因此跨标签的视觉相似性不会被触发重复去除. 在每类中,以EXIF为导向的RGB8像素身份并声明源身份识别出确切的重复. 直接的知觉-hash匹配需要哈明相距最多为两相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相距相 代表倾向于较大的本土图像,然后是无损失的编码,并有被种子打断的领带. 标签相冲突的像素-同声记录作为标签冲突单独处理.

blocks.en: Group-Disjoint Partitioning. Each discovery configuration pairs a fitting pool of the specified size with a held-out development set. We partition by complete source-origin groups, keeping original images, their derivatives, and inherited duplicate relations on the same side. The development set selects the decision threshold of the reference detector and is reserved for forward evaluation with the fit-derived F-space and mapped writing sites fixed; its images are excluded from component discovery, classifier fitting, and adapter optimization. The reported discovery budgets count fitting images; each development set contains 20% as many images as its fitting pool (100 at 0.5K).
blocks.zh: 集团 - 分离分割. 每个发现配置都配有指定大小的配对池并配有被搁置的开发集. 我们按完整的源源组进行分割,保留原始图像,它们的衍生物,并继承了同一面的重复关系. 开发集选择了参考探测器的决定阈值,并保留用于前期评价,固定了适配的F-空间和被映射的写作站点;其图像被排除在组件发现、分类器配置和适配器优化之外。 所报道的发现预算计算出配相图像;每套开发集包含的图像数量为配相池的20%(以0.5K计为100).

blocks.en: Hierarchical Coverage and Weighting. Each discovery budget allocates half its unique images to each class. We first assign domain or generation-category quotas using normalized target weights and largest-remainder integer allocation, resolving ties by canonical category key. Within each real domain, available underlying sources receive equal allocation before selection cycles through source variants. Fake categories are divided into capture-format or source-type subgroups where needed, then allocated equally across available generator families, with generator identities selected in rotation. This hierarchy distributes coverage across distinct underlying sources and families before adding more variants. When a group exhausts its eligible images, its unused allocation is redistributed among groups with remaining capacity. Sample ordering and within-group rotation use a fixed seed.
blocks.zh: 分级覆盖与重量. 每个发现预算将它独特的图像一半分配给每个类. 我们首先使用常态化的目标权重和最大剩余整数分配来分配域或生成类配额,用犬类键解决关系. 在每个实际领域,现有基础源通过源变体在选择周期前获得平等的分配. 根据需要,假分类分为捕捉格式分组或源类型分组,然后在可用的发电机家族之间公平分配,轮流选择发电机身份。 这种等级制度在增加更多变种之前,将覆盖面分布在不同的原始来源和家庭。 当一个团体耗尽其合格图像时,其未用分配在剩余容量的团体之间重新分配. 样本订购和组内自转使用固定种子.

blocks.en: Concentration and Resolution Constraints. Caps limit domination by an individual generator or capture format: single generators, reduced face crops, and released video frames are limited to 4%, 12%, and 16% of the fake half, respectively. Derivative generators are capped at 3%, and GAN-era, established-base, and derivative generators together at 12%. Resolution uses four native longest-edge bands: below 640, 640–1,023, 1,024–2,047, and at least 2,048 pixels. For pools up to 5K, their target shares are 28/5/57/10% within each class, with a 10-percentage-point tolerance per band. At larger scales, the highest-resolution band instead has a 3% lower bound in the fake class. At all scales, corresponding real/fake band shares differ by at most 14 percentage points. Resolution adjustments first seek replacements within the same source or generator, then widen to its domain or family/category while preserving earlier pool membership and decreasing constraint excess.
blocks.zh: 浓度和分辨率限制。 盖子限制单个生成器或捕捉格式的支配:单相发生器,减少面部收成,并放出相机相框分别限制在假相的4%,12%和16%. 衍生发电机的上限为3%,而GAN时代、已建立基地和衍生发电机的上限为12%。 分辨率使用4个本土最长的对接带:低于640,640–1,023,1,024–2,047和至少2,048像素. 对于不超过5K的集合,他们的目标份额是每班28/5/57/10%,每个波段的容忍度为10个百分点。 在更大的尺度上,最高分辨率的波段在假类中反之有3%的下限. 在所有尺度上,对应的真/假相带份额相差最多为14个百分点. 分辨率调整首先寻求在同一来源或生成器内进行替换,然后扩大到其领域或家族/类别,同时保留早先的集合成员,并减少制约性过剩。

blocks.en: Nested Budget Construction. We build pools from small to large. Each larger pool retains all previously selected image identities, treats their category counts as lower bounds, and fills the remaining quotas from unused images. Constraint-driven replacements operate only on newly added images. The resulting manifests record membership, realized category and resolution counts, and any unfilled constraints, making the selection outcome traceable to its profile and budget. Our budgets are 0.5K, 1K, 2K, 5K, 10K, and 20K. Figure 8 instantiates the category weights and reports realized composition; within the mainstream category, native full-frame/reduced-raster targets are 85/15, while face swapping balances native news-image and processed 256-pixel face-crop sources equally.
blocks.zh: 巢湖预算建设. 我们从小到大建造游泳池。 每个较大的集合保留了之前所选择的所有图像身份,将其类别计数作为下限,并填补未使用图像的剩余配额. 受约束驱动的替换仅在新添加的图像上运行. 由此产生的清单记录了会员情况、已实现的类别和分辨率以及任何未填补的限制,使甄选结果可追溯到其概况和预算。 我们的预算是0.5K、1K、2K、5K、10K和20K。 图8将类别加权数和报告实现的构成情况进行即时分析;在主流类别中,本土全帧/减速目标为85/15,而面对的互换则平衡本土新闻-图像和处理的256-像素相貌-作物来源。

blocks.en: Training Configuration. FRA uses AdamW with learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , zero weight decay, and gradient-norm clipping at 1.0 1.0 . The effective batch size is 64 for 0.5K/1K and 256 for the larger pools. Training samples the balanced fitting pool uniformly with replacement; one epoch denotes N N image draws. Reported checkpoints use four epochs for 0.5K–5K, two for 10K, and one for 20K. Representation processing, classifier fitting, and the FRA objective are specified in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Benchmark Baselines and Training Data. Table 1 compares RGE with UnivFD ( Ojha et al., 2023 ) , DRCT ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , AIDE ( Yan et al., 2025a ) , DDA ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , HiDA-Net ( Mu et al., 2026 ) , DGS-Net ( Yan et al., 2026 ) , LTD ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and PLM ( Zhou et al., 2026a ) . Training counts refer to detector training and exclude backbone pretraining. Wherever available, we adopt the values reported in the official benchmark comparisons; for entries not reported there, we evaluate the officially released weights under each benchmark’s standard protocol. HiDA-Net has not released its weights, so its unreported entries are marked N/A.
blocks.zh: 基准基线和培训数据。 表1将RGE与UnivFD(Ojha等,2023年),DRCT(Chen等,2024年),AIDE(Yan等,2025年a),DDA比较。 (Chen等人,2025年b),HiDA-Net(Mu等人,2026年),DGS-Net(Yan等人,2026年),LTD (杨等,2026年),和PLM (周等,2026a. 培训计数是指探测器培训,不包括骨干预训. 如果有的话,我们采用官方基准比较中报告的数值;对于没有报告的条目,我们评价每个基准标准协议中正式公布的权重。 HiDA-Net尚未发布其权重,因此其未报告的条目被标记为N/A.

blocks.en: AIGIBench. DGS-Net uses the 144K-image Setting-II split and preserves CLIP priors through distillation-guided gradient surgery during LoRA adaptation ( Li et al., 2025b ; Yan et al., 2026 ) . DDA adapts DINOv2 with LoRA on 236K COCO originals and SD2.1 VAE reconstructions aligned in the pixel and frequency domains ( Chen et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: AIGIBENCH. DGS-Net使用144K-图像设定-II分机,在LORA改造期间通过蒸馏制导梯度外科保存CLIP前科(Li等,2025年b; Yan等, 2026 (英语). DDA在236KCO原作上与LORA相适应DINov2和SD2.1 VAE重建在像素和频率领域对齐(Chen等,2025b;Li等,2025b.).

blocks.en: Chameleon. AIDE combines DCT-selected patches with a CLIP ConvNeXt trunk and is trained on the full GenImage set ( Yan et al., 2025a ) . The published DRCT reference follows the 473K-image SD2.1 configuration reported by GAPL ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2026 ) . DDA uses the same 236K training configuration as on AIGIBench ( Chen et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh: 变色龙. AIDE将DCT选取的补丁与CLIP ConvNEXt干线结合,并接受全基因组集的培训(Yan等,2025a.). 已公布的DRCT参考文献沿用了GAPL报告的473K-image SD2.1配置(Chen等,2024;Qin等,2026). 裁军部使用与AIGIBench(Chen等,2025年b)相同的236K培训配置。

blocks.en: HiRes-50K. The published Acc values for UnivFD, AIDE, DRCT (ConvB), and HiDA-Net follow the benchmark authors’ comparison with full-GenImage training and averaging across eight resolution intervals ( Mu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: HiRes -50K (英语). 公布的UnivFD、AIDE、DRCT(ConvB)和HiDA-Net的Acc值遵循基准作者与全GenImage培训的比较,并按8个分辨率间隔平均计算(Mu等,2026年)。

blocks.en: Computed Reference Values. Computed entries are obtained from officially released checkpoints under each benchmark’s evaluation protocol. They comprise DRCT mAP/Acc on AIGIBench; DDA mAP and DGS-Net, LTD, and PLM mAP/Acc on Chameleon; and UnivFD, AIDE, and DRCT mAP plus DDA, DGS-Net, LTD, and PLM mAP/Acc on HiRes-50K. HiRes-50K values are macro-averaged over the eight resolution intervals, as for RGE.
blocks.zh: 计算出参考值. 根据每个基准的评估协议,从官方公布的检查站获得计算入帐。 它们包括:AIGIBENCH上的DDCT mAP/Acc;DDA mAP和DGS-Net、LTD和Chameleon上的PLM mAP/Acc;UnivFD、AIDE和DDC mAP加DDA、DGS-Net、LTD和HiRes-50K上的PLM mAP/Acc。 HiRes-50K值在8个分辨率间隔中进行宏观平均,RGE也是如此.

blocks.en: This section specifies how F-lens decomposes sampled backbone activations and selects the forensic reserve, how synthesis mapping defines the writing subspaces, and how FRA learns updates within them. blocks.en: Writing Capacity. Table 3 reports writing ranks and trainable capacities for six retained component fractions at discovery sizes of 0.5K, 5K, and 20K. At a fixed 1%, the candidate count and resulting writing ranks vary across discovery sets. At a fixed discovery size, increasing the retained fraction expands the writing budget. blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: RGE localizes the forensic reserve with a linear decomposition at fixed layer–token sites and a single global component budget, so origin information carried by nonlinear or cross-site interactions is not explicitly captured. The reserve is localized with a single curated discovery pipeline, and discovery collections assembled from other sources remain to be examined. Our evaluation covers image forgery detection with ViT backbones; video, audio, and non-transformer architectures remain untested, as does robustness to adaptive attacks designed to evade the elicited cues. The functional analyses test the contribution of the learned writes within trained detectors rather than providing a complete mechanistic account of how origin evidence is computed. Extending reserve-guided elicitation to these settings is left for future work.
blocks.zh: RGE将法证储备本地化,在固定的地层-接地点进行线性分解,并编制单一的全球组成部分预算,因此,非线性或跨地相互作用所携带的源信息没有被明确捕获。 保留地是局部的,有单一的地道式发现管道,从其他来源收集的发现藏品仍有待审查。 我们的评价包括使用ViT主干线的图像伪造检测;视频、音频和非翻译架构仍然没有经过测试,对旨在躲避被引出提示的适应性攻击的强性也是如此。 功能分析在训练有素的探测器内检验所学写作的贡献,而不是对起源证据如何计算提供完整的机械说明。 将保留指南引出到这些环境,留待今后开展工作。

blocks.en: Q1. Could the discovery set overlap with the evaluation benchmarks? The discovery set is assembled without reference to the evaluation benchmarks: no benchmark image, label, or statistic is inspected during source selection, curation, or sampling (Appendix A ). Because both draw on public image sources, we cannot rule out that isolated images coincide, and we do not deduplicate against the benchmarks. Such coincidences are unlikely to explain our results. First, the main configuration fits on 500 images, whereas each benchmark contains approximately 26K–359K evaluation images. Second, our central quantity is the change from the baseline reference detector to RGE; both are fitted on the same discovery pool, so any overlap is shared and cannot by itself produce the gain from eliciting the forensic reserve.
blocks.zh: 问题1. 发现是否与评价基准重叠? 发现集是在不参照评价基准的情况下组装的:在选择来源、整理或取样时没有检查基准图像、标签或统计数据(附录A)。 因为两者都取自公共图像来源,我们不能排除孤立图像的吻合性,我们不会与基准相悖. 这种巧合不可能解释我们的结果。 首先,主要配置符合500个图像,而每个基准包含约26K-359K的评价图像. 第二,我们的核心数量是从基线参考探测器改为RGE;两者都安装在同一发现池上,因此任何重叠都是共享的,其本身不能产生引出法证储备的收益。

blocks.en: Q2. How faithful are the reported results of competing methods? We prioritize the values reported in the official benchmark comparisons. When a metric is not reported, we evaluate the latest officially released weights under the benchmark’s standard protocol and adopt the computed value after confirming that the same evaluation reproduces the method’s published values where available, up to small decimal-level differences. Methods without released weights are marked N/A rather than reimplemented, and Appendix A lists which entries are published and which are computed. We therefore believe the comparison faithfully reflects the performance of each method.
blocks.zh: 问题2. 据报竞争方法的结果如何忠实? 我们优先考虑官方基准比较中报告的数值。 当一个度量衡没有被报告时,我们根据基准的标准协议来评价最新的官方公布的加权,并在确认同一评价在可行的情况下复制了该方法的已公布数值之后采用计算值,最高为小数级。 没有释放权重的方法被标记为N/A,而不是重新执行,附录A则列出公布和计算条目。 因此,我们认为,这种比较忠实地反映了每种方法的业绩。
